item.spudiversity.noname_potato.tooltip: 「A potato of strange coloration. Its skin is a silent crimson-purple, yet its eyes shimmer with a warm, bright yellow.」
item.spudiversity.noname_potato.tooltip_: 「It has no taste, no scent, yet holding it brings a peculiar calm, as if clutching a heart that has ceased to beat.」

「You are certain it came from the hands of someone immensely important. Their figure is blurred in your memory, as if seen through an endless snowfall. The only thing clear is the words you never spoke when they left.」
「...Consume it. Perhaps you will find answers within, or perhaps oblivion.」
‘Eat it. It might not do much, but... it'll fill you up.’
A voice sounds in your mind, its gender blurred, carrying laughter and a trace of... undetectable weariness.
The voice sends a sharp pain through you, like an ice pick to the temple, followed by an immense, suffocating emptiness.
Who are you? Who was I?
That requires such a silent potato to serve as the final anchor, against the inevitable, complete oblivion?
